question: Who was the first defence minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Baldev Singh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Baldev Singh was appointed as the first Defence Minister of independent India in 1947.
 
• He played a significant role in integrating the princely states into the Indian Union.
 
• During his tenure, India faced the Indo-Pakistani War of 1947-1948 over the disputed territory of Kashmir.
 
• Baldev Singh's efforts were crucial in setting up the infrastructure for India's defence forces post-independence.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Kailash Nath Katju
 Served as the Defence Minister of India from 1955 to 1957.
 
 

 2) Baldev Singh
 First Defence Minister of India, serving from 1947 to 1952.
 
 

 3) YB Chavan
 Served as the Defence Minister of India during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965.
 
 

 4) Swaran Singh
 Known for his tenure as Defence Minister during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971.
